nodes.description: Public mapping(address => uint) storing token balances; written without SafeMath in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of spend approvals; decremented with raw arithmetic in transferFrom.
Private owner address set in the constructor from msg.sender; used for privilege checks in delegate, batchSend and the ensure modifier.
Total token supply assigned once in the constructor; never mutated afterwards.
Constant internal address of the router/pair used in the ensure modifier's pairFor computation.
Public payable transfer(address,uint) that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Public payable transferFrom guarded by the ensure modifier; mutates allowance and balanceOf with unchecked arithmetic.
Public payable approve(address,uint) that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a user supplied address with user supplied calldata.
Owner-only batch distribution that computes total = _value * _tos.length and credits balances in a loop with unchecked arithmetic.
Internal pure helper that deterministically derives a Uniswap-style pair address from factory and token pair.
Modifier on transferFrom that recomputes the pair via pairFor and requires _from == owner || _to == owner || _from == UNI.
Payable constructor that sets name, symbol, totalSupply, owner = msg.sender, mints the whole supply and grants unlimited allowance to the router.
Caller-controlled address used for allowance accounting, owner assignment and owner-only access checks.
a.delegatecall(b) executes arbitrary code from a caller-chosen address in the storage context of this contract.
Raw subtraction/credit of allowance and balances (_value) without SafeMath, allowing unchecked underflow in older solc semantics.
Raw multiplication _value * _tos.length and raw balance mutations inside the loop, plus duplicated/incorrect Transfer events of _value/2.
Recipient address parameter of transfer().
Amount parameter of transfer().
Debited address parameter of transferFrom(), constrained by ensure.
Credited address parameter of transferFrom(), constrained by ensure.
Amount parameter of transferFrom() used in unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic.
Spender address parameter of approve().
Approval amount parameter of approve().
Target address of the low-level delegatecall in delegate().
Raw calldata bytes forwarded to delegatecall in delegate().
Dynamic array of recipient addresses in batchSend(); its length scales the unchecked total.
Per-recipient amount parameter of batchSend().
Local total = _value * _tos.length computed without overflow protection.
Loop-local recipient address copied from _tos[i].
From address passed into the ensure modifier and compared against owner/UNI.
To address passed into the ensure modifier and compared against owner.

edges.reason: transfer() forwards the _to recipient parameter into transferFrom.
transfer() forwards the _value amount parameter into transferFrom.
transferFrom() takes _from as the debited address parameter.
transferFrom() takes _to as the credited address parameter.
transferFrom() uses _value directly in unchecked allowance and balance mutations.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] using the _spender parameter.
approve() stores the _value parameter into the allowance mapping.
delegate() passes the caller-supplied address a to a low-level delegatecall.
delegate() passes the caller-supplied calldata b to a low-level delegatecall.
batchSend() iterates over the _tos array and multiplies by its length.
batchSend() uses the _value parameter in unchecked arithmetic.
batchSend() computes the local total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath.
batchSend() credits balanceOf[_to] inside the loop with unchecked addition.
ensure modifier compares the _from parameter against owner and the derived UNI pair.
ensure modifier compares the _to parameter against owner.
transfer() uses msg.sender as the implicit _from when calling transferFrom.
transferFrom() compares msg.sender with _from and charges allowance[_from][msg.sender].
approve() sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender] using the untrusted caller.
delegate() gates execution with require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend() gates execution with require(msg.sender == owner).
constructor sets owner = msg.sender, granting unlimited mint/allowance control to the deployer.
The owner state variable is derived from the untrusted msg.sender.
transfer() delegates all state changes to transferFrom().
transferFrom() is guarded by the ensure modifier before any state mutation.
ensure modifier reads the owner state variable for its access restriction.
ensure modifier references the constant UNI address in its check.
ensure modifier calls pairFor() to derive the allowed pair address.
delegate() reaches the arbitrary delegatecall sink using attacker-influenced target and data.
The target address a is the code executed by the delegatecall sink.
The bytes b are the calldata executed by the delegatecall sink.
The delegatecall is only reachable while msg.sender equals owner.
batchSend() requires msg.sender to equal owner before distributing balances.
batchSend() performs unchecked multiplication and balance additions that reach the unsafe arithmetic sink.
batchSend() mutates balanceOf[msg.sender] and balanceOf[_to] with raw subtraction/addition.
The _value parameter feeds the unchecked multiplications and credits in batchSend().
The _tos array length is multiplied without overflow checking to form total.
transferFrom() writes allowance and balances with raw arithmetic reaching the unchecked arithmetic sink.
transferFrom() performs allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value without SafeMath.
transferFrom() performs balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value without SafeMath.
The _value parameter drives the unchecked subtraction that can underflow.
approve() writes the allowance mapping directly with the supplied value.
Constructor assigns the privileged owner role.
Constructor initializes totalSupply from the supplied _supply.
Constructor credits the full supply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
Constructor pre-approves the router with an unlimited allowance of uint(-1).
transfer() ultimately changes balances through the transferFrom() call.

The _value parameter is only meaningful inside transfer().
The _from parameter participates in the allowance/balance mutations of transferFrom().
The _to parameter receives the credited balance inside transferFrom().
The _value parameter drives the unchecked arithmetic sink in transferFrom().
The _spender parameter keys the allowance write in approve().
The _value parameter is stored as the approval amount in approve().
The target address a is the receiver of the delegatecall sink.
The calldata b is the payload of the delegatecall sink.
The _tos array length feeds the unchecked total computation in batchSend().
The _value parameter feeds the unchecked arithmetic sink in batchSend().
The local total is the unchecked product used by batchSend().
The loop-local _to receives the unchecked balance credit in batchSend().
The _from parameter is compared with owner/UNI inside the ensure modifier.
The _to parameter is compared with owner inside the ensure modifier.
